registration.statement: Critical violations detected per routine initial inspection are not even across Manhattan's 2020 NTAs: after cuisine, chain status, quarter, day of week, daily inspection workload, new-restaurant status and the NTA's restaurant count, the between-NTA variation exceeds a permutation null, with a between-NTA standard deviation of 5 to 20 percent.

prediction.support_if: Permutation p <= 0.01 (10,000 draws, seed 20261113) AND tau >= 0.05.
prediction.refute_if: Permutation p > 0.10 (the NTAs are as even as random assignment of restaurants to NTAs).
prediction.other: p <= 0.01 with tau < 0.05 means statistically detectable but practically even and is unsettled under rule 2. Per rule 9 the p condition is re-checked with 100,000 draws and other seeds; if it is met under some and not others, it is neither met nor unmet.

registration.plan: Script analyses/restaurants/evenness_test.py at commit 48147d6. Fixed source: Underlay nyc/restaurant-inspections v1.0.0 (hash ulv2:07a7f08a0d5c85649920f8adc6946d27c17f5e2d75e9ee07c0ad4ae0fcc6739c), Manhattan inspections 2024-01-02 to 2026-06-09, chosen because the live table drops closed restaurants and revises recent violations downward (docs/underlay_drift.md). NTA by point in polygon (9nt8-h7nd); NTAs with < 20 restaurants dropped. Unit: Cycle Inspection / Initial Inspection; outcome: critical violation records. Null Poisson GLM as in the script docstring; statistic S = sum over NTAs of (sum(y - mu))^2 / sum(mu); null by permuting NTA labels across restaurants. tau from an NTA fixed-effects model, SE clustered by restaurant, method of moments. A companion frequency test (cycle initial inspections per restaurant-year) is computed by the same script; its result was seen by accident during a synthetic-outcome check of the script before this registration, so it is reported as exploratory and is not registered.
alternatives: Inspector assignment: inspectors work in geographic teams, so an NTA's rate reflects its inspectors' stringency rather than its restaurants.
Unmeasured restaurant mix: size, menu complexity, age of premises and owner experience vary by NTA and are not in the data; cuisine is a weak proxy.
Building stock: older buildings have more pests (the most common critical violations are vermin), which is real hygiene, not harshness.
Clientele and complaints: complaint-driven attention may differ by NTA.
Adjudication: the snapshot holds violations before some hearings; dismissal rates may differ by NTA.

outcome.prediction_scored: miss. refute_if (permutation p > 0.10) is met: p = 0.307 with 10,000 draws; with 100,000 draws and four other seeds p lies in 0.305 to 0.313, far from the 0.10 threshold, so rule 9 does not apply. tau = 0.000, below the 0.05 floor of the predicted band. After adjustment the 31 NTAs are as even as a random assignment of restaurants.
outcome.settle: Inspector identifiers (not published) would separate inspector stringency from place; the NTA effect would then be decomposed into inspector and restaurant parts. Restaurant size, seats and age of premises would test whether the raw differences are restaurant mix.

outcome.notes: Raw critical violations per initial inspection range from 1.65 (Midtown-Times Square) to 2.37 (Chinatown-Two Bridges); unadjusted, the permutation statistic is 4.2 times its null mean (p < 0.001). Restaurant count alone brings it to 2.6, cuisine alone to 2.4, and the registered set to 1.11. The registered adjustment set accounts for the raw differences; the share due to each covariate was not separated further. Exploratory, not registered (its result was seen during a synthetic-outcome check of the script): routine initial inspections per restaurant-year, adjusted for first score band, cuisine, chain, restaurant count and new status, give p = 0.015 and tau = 0.016, detectable but small (adjusted rate ratios 0.95 to 1.08). Also exploratory: all cycle inspections with stage as covariate, p = 0.026. Fixed source is the Underlay snapshot because the live table drops closed restaurants and revises recent violations (docs/underlay_drift.md).
outcome.notes_referee: Referee p 0.323. Contested stands under rule 1, but refutes only place effects of ~5%+ (SD ~0.05 at 80% power); centred SD 0.024. Restaurant-count covariate alone moves p 0.008 -> 0.32, absorbing a density gradient (~3.5%, r = -0.51).

deciding.wrapper_note: Smallest wrapper: evenness_test.py reads the 51 MB Underlay snapshot from ~/opt, runs two tests and writes into the repository. code/prepare.py keeps only the fields load_snapshot() reads, and code/rerun.py calls load_snapshot(), assign_nta(), design(), permutation() and nta_effects() unchanged for the harshness test, with the registered 10,000 draws and seed 20261113. The rerun takes about a minute. The claim has no placebo; the permutation null is part of the deciding test.
